summary: B.O.S. Better Online Solutions filed a Form 6-K attaching its Notice of Meeting and Proxy Statement for the Annual General Meeting to be held December 10, 2026, plus a form of proxy. The equivalent US filing is a DEF 14A-style annual meeting proxy. Agenda items are routine: re-election of Yaron Eldad as a Class B director, a one-time CEO bonus payable in shares, a CEO bonus plan amendment, a corporate name change to BOS Technologies Ltd. requiring 75% approval, an amended compensation policy, auditor appointment, and review of FY2025 financials. Record date is October 26, 2026. No special-situation event; watch the name-change supermajority and controlling-shareholder vote mechanics.
